turns.result:
The users test now passes.

The bug was a column name mismatch. Migration `001` creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` read and wrote `full_name`. The insert therefore failed with `unknown column users.full_name`.

I changed `src/api/users.js` in two places, `createUser` and `getUser`, to use `fullname`. The public `fullName` field in the API output is unchanged. I didn't touch `migrations/`, since those are already applied in production and owned by the DBA team.
